description: Lightweight string utility atoms (truncate-to-length, ASCII check) that operate on the opaque Str type used elsewhere in std (see std/core.mm and std/effects.mm). Atoms return i64 (length / boolean) so the contracts can be discharged using Z3 integer theory without committing to a string theory. The generated file MUST begin with a header comment block (// ======) identifying the module as 'std/string_utils — verified string utilities'. Comments must be in Japanese to match the surrounding std style. Each atom follows the convention used in std/core.mm: `atom name(params) requires: ...; ensures: ...; body: { ... };`. Do NOT invent new operators, types, or syntax — use only what std/core.mm already uses.

atoms.name: safe_truncate
atoms.description: Return the truncated length of `s` capped at `max_len`. Output is a non-negative length, so callers can use it as a slice bound without further checks.

atoms.name: is_ascii
atoms.description: Return 1 if `s` is ASCII-only, 0 otherwise. The boolean is encoded as i64 so the contract is provable with Z3 integer theory.
